resources.string: OpenKinGuard 亲友守护
Recently verified contacts and shortcuts to test SOS and check in
Home-screen shortcuts with an in-app confirmation step
Pair devices by QR
Pinned trust can be used for local-network exercises. Public-Internet emergency delivery and remote revocation synchronization are not yet available.
The person needing help starts. Exchange four signed QR codes, checking the other device fingerprint in person at each step.
I need help: create invitation
I help someone: scan invitation
Scan the next QR from the other phone
Scan OpenKinGuard pairing QR
Pairing phase: %1$s
Step 1: show this QR to your helper, then scan their response QR.
Step 2: verified invitation. Confirm that you know this person and agree to receive and respond to their alerts.
Step 2: show your response QR to the subject, then scan their grant QR.
Step 3: verified response. The subject must explicitly grant alert and response permissions to this helper.
Step 3: show grant QR to the helper, then scan the final acknowledgement QR.
Step 4: verified grant. The helper must explicitly accept this one-way relationship and generate the final receipt.
Step 4: show the final receipt to the subject. Only after their screen says completed, confirm below.
Pairing complete. Return home to test LAN exercises.
I verified the person and fingerprints together and explicitly approve
Other device fingerprint (first 24): %1$s…
Approve and generate next QR
Other phone scanned and shows completed
Cancel this pairing / start another
Temporary pairing cleared; existing relationships retained
Invitation created; expires in 10 minutes
Confirmed locally; show the new QR
Signed QR verified; user approval is still required where shown
Rejected or failed: %1$s
QR rendering failed; retry
Pairing QR for the other phone to scan
Active local trust records: %1$d
Trusted key pinned; LAN exercises are supported, Internet delivery and remote revocation sync are not
Locally revoked, cannot silently reactivate
Revoke local trust
Local trust revoked; peer has not been notified over a network
